title: Senior Account Executive II, Financial Services
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

 Join Collibra's Sales team as a Senior Account Executive, Financial Services - East Coast

 Collibra is the Data Intelligence company, helping organizations maximize the value of their data through trusted, governed, and meaningful data access — empowering many of the world's leading financial institutions to scale data-driven decision-making while meeting the most demanding regulatory and compliance requirements.

 As a Senior Account Executive within Collibra's Financial Services vertical, you will spearhead a premier portfolio of strategic East Coast accounts, ranging from global investment firms to some of the nation's largest commercial banking institutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and Financial Services leaders, navigating them through the complexities of data and AI governance to unlock a distinct competitive advantage. Your mission is to build brand authority and serve as a Data Intelligence visionary across the entire customer lifecycle, driving demand, accelerating adoption, and leading expansion efforts within a territory of top-tier incumbents and high-growth financial prospects.

 Senior Account Executives, Financial Services at Collibra are responsible for

• Prospecting for net new FinServ accounts, greenfield building, and developing relationships with existing customers to maintain active deal pipeline and ideal quota coverage in your territory.

• Managing and creating demand for expansion on existing FinServ customers to widen the footprint of Collibra within these accounts.

• Managing complex deal cycles, from lead origination to stakeholder mapping, through negotiation to close and expansion.

• Successfully collaborating with customers, partners, and peers in a consultative sales process where you will identify value and ROI aligned to the specific data governance and compliance needs of financial institutions.

• Reliable, accurate forecasting, with Salesforce updates reflective of real-time activity.

 You have

• At least 2–3 years of experience in Data Management, Data/AI Governance, or FinServ technology sales, with deep familiarity with the regulatory landscapes and data complexities inherent to the financial sector.

• A proven ability to originate and lead complex, value-based sales cycles, navigating multiple technical and business stakeholders to secure both net-new business and strategic expansions.

• A successful history of developing high-profile, long-term relationships with C-level buyers and stakeholders across the financial services ecosystem.

• Consistently achieved or overachieved your SaaS sales quota.

• Managed consultative sales processes, utilizing established sales methodologies to drive predictable, impact-driven outcomes.

• Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent related working experience.

• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

 You are

• Composed and resourceful, remaining focused and effective in fast-paced, evolving environments.

• Known for your integrity and a trusted advisor approach to the customer journey.

• A precise communicator and persuasive negotiator who can translate technical data governance concepts into compelling business outcomes for executive leadership

• Adaptive, accountable, and execution-oriented.

• Proud of your work, aim for excellence in every interaction, and are flexible to travel as required to support your accounts.

 Measures of success

• Within your first month, you have completed onboarding, connected with your team members as well as with your functional peers.

• Within your third month, you will be in the midst of building a pipeline of business within your assigned FinServ accounts and territory.

• Within your sixth month, you will have a solid foundation of prospective FinServ clients who you will be close to closing, and will be well-positioned as a trusted advisor in the Data Intelligence market for Financial Services companies.

 Compensation for this role

 The standard base salary range for this position is $140,000 - $175,000 per year. This position is eligible for additional commission-based compensation. Salary offers are based on a combination of factors, including, but not limited to, experience, skills, and location. In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive total rewards package, including bonus potential, equity for eligible roles, a Flex Fund monthly stipend, pension/401k plans, and more.

 Benefits at Collibra

 Collibra recognizes and values that everyone has different needs, interests, and life goals. We built our benefits program with flexibility in mind to support you and your loved ones through a diverse range of circumstances and life events. These flexible offerings sit on a foundation of competitive compensation, health coverage, and time off. Learn more about Collibra’s benefits .

 We create inclusion and belonging through how we onboard, meet, connect, engage, and communicate. Learn more about diversity, equity, and inclusion at Collibra.

 At Collibra, we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We realize the key to creating a company with a world-class culture and employee experience comes from who we hire and creating a workplace that celebrates everyone.

 With this, we proudly consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, pregnancy, sex, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, physical or mental disability, HIV status, registered domestic partner status, caregiver status, marital status, veteran or military status, citizenship status or any other legally protected category. If you have a need that requires accommodation, let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/collibra-senior-account-executive-ii-financial-services

title: Teacher of Mathematics
location: Bishop's Stortford, East of England, GB
description:
Hockerill Anglo-European College is a thriving, diverse and forward-thinking state boarding school with a proud international ethos. As an IB World School, we are committed to developing inquiring, knowledgeable and open-minded young people who are equipped to make a positive contribution to the world around them. Alongside GCSEs, we offer the International Baccalaureate Middle Years and Diploma Programmes and, from September 2027, will broaden our post-16 provision to include A Levels, ensuring that every student can follow the pathway best suited to their strengths, aspirations and future plans.

Mathematics is a highly valued subject within the College and plays a central role in our strong academic tradition. We are seeking an enthusiastic and talented Teacher of Mathematics to join our successful and supportive department. The successful candidate will be passionate about their subject, committed to delivering outstanding teaching and learning, and able to inspire, challenge and motivate students across all key stages.

This is an exciting opportunity for either an experienced teacher or an Early Career Teacher to join a collaborative department with a strong record of academic success. For suitably qualified and experienced candidates, there may be the opportunity to undertake additional responsibilities, with appropriate remuneration, subject to experience and the needs of the College.

As a thriving boarding and international community, Hockerill offers a rich and varied educational experience extending well beyond the classroom. The successful candidate will be expected to contribute fully to the wider life of the College through enrichment activities, trips, exchanges and the extensive co-curricular programme for which Hockerill is renowned.

We are committed to supporting the professional development of our staff and offer a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement and high aspirations. Whether you are at the beginning of your teaching career or looking for your next challenge, this role offers an excellent opportunity to develop professionally within a successful and highly respected school.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK, as we are unable to provide visa sponsorship.

Early applications are encouraged. We reserve the right to interview and appoint prior to the closing date should a suitable candidate be identified.We are committed to providing students with a rich variety of opportunities beyond the classroom, and the successful candidate will be expected to contribute to this by supporting our existing extra-curricular programme or by introducing new activities that further enhance its breadth and impact.

Hockerill is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people and expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment. All appointments are subject to satisfactory pre-employment checks, including an enhanced Disclosure and Barring Service (DBS) check and barred list check where appropriate.

We strive to be an inclusive and diverse workplace that reflects the diversity of our student population. Applications from Black, Asian and minority ethnic candidates are particularly welcome.

title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), Create: Change Record
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

We are looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Change Record team within GitLab’s Source Code stage. As AI agents increasingly write code alongside people, every change needs a clear, trustworthy record of what changed, why, and who or what made it. You’ll build that record into GitLab’s source code experience, for humans and agents alike. This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development.

That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Source Code provides the interface layer, through Gitaly, to the Git repositories behind a large share of GitLab traffic, so you’ll help keep it reliable through performance tuning, caching, rate limiting, observability, and resiliency, collaborating with product, design, security, Gitaly, Code Review, and Source Code Experience teams. Supporting production systems and improving established experiences are central to the role, especially while you’re onboarding, and over time you’ll also help build experiences for developers working with agents.

You'll work remotely from the United Kingdom or Poland.

What you’ll do

  • Develop secure, well-tested, performant features and improvements using Ruby on Rails and GraphQL, among other technologies.
  • Work through complex requirements and legacy constraints to deliver clear solutions while protecting the reliability of this critical system.
  • Design and maintain backend services, APIs, data models, and business logic that support intuitive source code workflows.
  • Collaborate across functions and teams, both asynchronously and synchronously, and involve domain experts when their input will improve the outcome.
  • Use AI agents for well-scoped work when they can speed up delivery without sacrificing quality, and critically review their output.
  • Write maintainable code that follows GitLab's standards and contribute to constructive code reviews.
  • Help strengthen reliability by monitoring production health metrics, participating in Tier 2 on-call, troubleshooting incidents, contributing to root cause analysis, and improving observability and resiliency.
  • Share knowledge through code review, technical documentation, and everyday collaboration while learning from others.

What you’ll bring

  • Professional experience building backend web applications, services, or application programming interfaces, with experience using Ruby and GraphQL.
  • An understanding of relational databases, structured query language, data modeling, caching, background processing, and backend performance practices.
  • Experience with full-stack development to build and maintain user-facing workflows and their underlying systems.
  • Experience writing backend unit and integration tests, with familiarity with the testing pyramid, Git, and collaborative code review processes.
  • Clear written and spoken English communication skills, including sharing useful status updates in a remote, asynchronous environment.
  • The ability to manage assigned priorities, work through ambiguity, take ownership of your work, and seek guidance when needed.
  • Experience using AI coding agents to speed up software development while critically reviewing their output.
  • Bonus: you’ve built agents or agent-based workflows that run in production, not just prototypes.

About the team

The functional team works across Europe and North America, supporting both synchronous and asynchronous collaboration. It includes four engineers, comprising both backend and frontend engineers. We work closely with other Source Code teams, Agentic Preview, Repository Services, and Hardening, as well as other teams in the company such as the Gitaly team, and the AI Governance team.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the EU, applicable in the specified country or countries only. Sales roles are also eligible for incentive pay targeted at up to 100% of the offered base salary. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location and having regard to any applicable collective agreements. The base salary range does not include bonuses, equity, or benefits.

Poland base salary range: 248,000zł - 372,000zł

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave

Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Backend Engineer (Ruby), AI Engineering: Agent Foundations
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As an Intermediate Backend Engineer in GitLab's Agent Foundations stage, you'll go beyond using AI tools. You'll help build the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences: the platform that lets AI agents work across the whole software delivery lifecycle, not just write code. That covers how agents are created, shared and connected to tools inside and outside GitLab, how they run, and how their work shows up and can be observed across GitLab.

In this role you'll work closely with engineers across the stage and other AI Engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area where GitLab's core platform meets its AI strategy.

What you'll do

  • Develop, ship and maintain features for the Duo Agent Platform in the GitLab monolith (Ruby) and, where needed, the AI Gateway (Python). Keep them secure, well-tested and performant.
  • Work with Product Management, UX, frontend, backend and AI specialists to refine requirements and ship improvements in small iterations.
  • Design, implement and review GraphQL and REST APIs and the backend logic behind them, with reliable, scalable and clear contracts for clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing (RSpec and other frameworks) to strengthen quality and give developers faster feedback.
  • Share standards, patterns and learnings with other engineers to raise the bar for responsible AI integration and evidence-driven engineering.
  • Join Tier 2 on-call rotations to troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Keep an eye on the competitive landscape to help keep GitLab's agent platform best-in-class.

What you'll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production Ruby on Rails applications, including background jobs, APIs and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase. Familiarity with Python backends and/or Vue frontends is a plus.
  • Skill in designing or extending REST and/or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability and backward compatibility.
  • Real enthusiasm for AI and hands-on experience using AI tools in your daily work. Experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations is a plus.
  • Proven SQL and experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including writing efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience finding and fixing performance bottlenecks in applications.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including technical proposals and documentation, in a remote, async, cross-functional team.
  • Openness to learning and to applying skills from related technologies or fields.

About the team

The Agent Foundations stage builds the foundations for GitLab's agentic AI experiences. We provide the platform, catalog and execution features that help teams deliver resilient agents and flows to customers. The stage has three groups: Agent Developer, AI Catalog and Agent Execution, they provide the core harness for GitLab’s agents, the tools Agent’s need to interact with GitLab as well as ways to configure and execute Agents across GitLab.Our engineers work async-first across EMEA and AMER timezones. We work with teams across AI engineering and the rest of GitLab so the Duo Agent Platform can power many of GitLab's AI features.

title: In reach - Lead
description:
Specialist Teaching Assistant (SEMH) - Maidenhall Primary School

Pay: L7

Hours: Full time - Monday - Friday 8.20am - 4.30pm (term time)

Are you passionate about supporting children with SEMH needs?

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a L7 Specialist Teaching Assistant (SEMH) at The Bridge in-reach service, based at Maidenhall Primary School.

Do you strongly believe that?

All behaviour is a form of communication

Relationships are the key to high quality learning

Every child deserves the chance to succeed

This role will give you the opportunity to drive real change—helping children with SEMH needs to thrive, shaping their future, and equipping them with the tools to reach their full potential.

About the Role

We are looking to recruit a specialist teaching assistant to plan and deliver bespoke education packages for individual pupils and small groups. Our work focuses on meeting SEMH needs, maintaining strong connections with pupils’ home schools, and facilitating reintegration into mainstream settings or transition to specialist provision where appropriate. The specialist teaching assistant will play a lead role within the team and oversee the daily line management of in-reach support staff.

The Bridge forms part of Luton’s Primary SEMH Service. The overarching aim of the service is to meet SEMH needs through outreach support and early intervention within schools. Where Tier 1 outreach support is not sufficient, pupils may be offered Tier 2 short term placements within The Bridge.

A key element of the service is the fostering of Therapeutic Thinking, supporting a cultural shift in how schools understand and respond to children’s needs.

What do we require?

NVQ 4 for Higher Level Teaching Assistants or equivalent qualification or equivalent experience

You to have the ability to build good working relationships and lead a team. Providing support, training and leadership when required.

You need to be self-motivated, flexible and enthusiastic.

Experience of working within a similar SEMH environment or role.

Good Numeracy and Literacy skills.

Experience of successfully supporting pupils in class, in small groups and working with an individual.

Thrive in a busy environment and enjoy new challenges.

Ability to drive and have a car would be advantageous for travelling to different schools in Luton.

We warmly welcome visits to our school and service. Meeting our Lead Practitioner and The Bridge team will give you valuable insight into our vision, values, and pupil pathways—and help you understand the impact you can have on our pupils.

Closing date: Monday 9th November 2026

Interview: Thursday 19th November or Friday 20th November 2026

All appointments will be subject to pre-employment checks, including an enhanced check with the Disclosure & Barring Service (DBS), as well as online searches.

title: SENCO - Associate Assistant Principal
description:
Job Title: Associate Assistant Principal 

Actual Annual Salary: £53,586 - £59,137  (L1 to L5) 

Contract Type: Permanent 

Hours: Full-time, 32.5 hours per week, 1.0 FTE

Provisional Start Date: 01 January 2027

We are looking for a passionate and inspiring qualified Associate Assistant Principal to join our supportive and talented leadership team at Lansdown Park Academy. We are seeking an ambitious and dedicated leader who is committed to transforming educational outcomes and ensuring every student achieves their full potential. 

What we are looking for 

We are looking for an exceptional practitioner and aspiring senior leader who will play a significant role in driving academy improvement and supporting the strategic direction of Lansdown Park Academy. You will be passionate about delivering high-quality education and committed to promoting a culture of high expectations, inclusion and continuous improvement. 

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of excellent classroom practice, experience of leading and developing colleagues, and the ability to inspire, motivate and support both staff and students. They will contribute to whole-school improvement priorities, working collaboratively with colleagues to raise standards, strengthen teaching and learning, and enhance outcomes for all learners. 

A well-qualified teacher holding Qualified Teacher Status (QTS) and a relevant degree, you will possess strong leadership, communication and organisational skills, alongside a commitment to safeguarding, inclusion and student wellbeing. You will be resilient, adaptable and able to build positive relationships with students, families, colleagues and external partners. 

As part of the academy's leadership team, you will help ensure the effective day-to-day operation of the school, support staff development, and contribute to creating a positive culture that enables all students and colleagues to thrive. This role offers an excellent opportunity for a talented leader looking to further develop their strategic leadership experience and progress towards an Assistant Principal position in the future. 

About Lansdown Park Academy: 

Lansdown Park Academy is a pupil referral unit/early intervention base in Stockwood in South Bristol.  

We provide education for pupils from KS1-3 who require additional support around their behaviour. Pupils receive a tailored curriculum that supports them to re-engage with education and to help prepare and plan for their next steps.  

We also offer a successful ‘outreach’ programme where pupils are supported through weekly intervention sessions but remain with their home school. 

Why CLF? 

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others. 

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion. 

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to the Teachers’ Pension Scheme. 
  • Comprehensive induction and ongoing support for career development and wellbeing.  
  • Sector-leading professional development entitlement and opportunities. 
  • Collaboration with colleagues across the trust through subject communities and specialist networks. 
  • Shared CLF curriculum, written and curated by trust experts, reducing individual teacher workload.   
  • Career enhancing and progression opportunities within the trust and through the CLF Institute. 
  • A collaborative culture which supports workload. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking and many more! 

Recruitment timeline: 

• Closing Date: 01 November 2026 @11.59pm 

• Short-listing: 02 November 2026 

• Interviews: 10 November 2026 

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment. 

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.  

Skilled Worker sponsorship: This role may be eligible for Skilled Worker visa sponsorship, subject to the candidate meeting the applicable Home Office eligibility and salary requirements. Full-time and 0.8 FTE positions will generally meet the required salary threshold; for other part-time working arrangements, eligibility will depend on the salary applicable to the role and the candidate's working pattern. To help us assess whether sponsorship may be available, we encourage candidates who require sponsorship to provide their current salary information when completing the application form. 

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.    

As a Disability Confident Committed Employer, we are dedicated to equity and inclusion and commit to interviewing applicants with a disability who meet the essential criteria. We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

Potential Start Date: January 2027 (Subject to completion of pre-employment checks) 

Make a difference by helping students overcome barriers to learning and achieve their full potential through personalised support, encouragement, and care. 

We are seeking a dedicated Teaching Assistant Level 1 to join the team at Kingsmead Academy. Working as part of a small, supportive team under the guidance of the SENDCO, you will play a vital role in supporting students with a wide range of learning, communication, and social needs. 

In this role, you will provide care and supervision for students both within the classroom and across the wider school environment. You will work closely with teaching staff to prepare learning resources, maintain a safe and engaging learning environment, and support the delivery of learning activities that enable all students to access the curriculum. You will adapt your approach to meet the needs of students with significantly varying abilities, ensuring appropriate differentiation and inclusion at all times. 

You will promote positive behaviour, independence, self-esteem, and resilience, helping students to develop the confidence and skills needed to succeed both academically and personally. Working collaboratively with colleagues, you will contribute to creating a supportive and nurturing environment where every student is encouraged to thrive and reach their full potential. 

About you:   

You will: 

  • Have a keen interest in working with children and a genuine commitment to inclusion, ensuring every student feels valued, supported and able to succeed. 
  • Understand the role of a Teaching Assistant and how effective support enables students to access learning, make progress and achieve their potential. 
  • Be able to build positive relationships with students, demonstrating patience, empathy and active listening. 
  • Be confident supporting students on a one-to-one basis and in small groups, using appropriate strategies to engage learners and promote positive behaviour. 
  • Have strong communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with colleagues, parents/carers and other professionals. 
  • Be adaptable and responsive to the varying needs of students, including those with SEND and additional learning needs. 
  • Have good organisational skills and be able to assist in the preparation of learning activities, resources and support materials. 
  • Work collaboratively as part of a team, contributing positively to student outcomes and the wider school community. 
  • Demonstrate good literacy and numeracy skills and be confident using IT to support learning and administrative tasks. 
  • Be committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare, safety and well-being of children and young people. 
  • Maintain professionalism, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive information. 
  • Be committed to continuous professional development, including undertaking relevant training and qualifications where appropriate. 
  • Be flexible, resilient and able to remain calm under pressure while supporting students with a wide range of needs. 

Applicants are advised to refer to the full requirements of the role in the attached job description and person specification, prior to submitting an application.   

About Kingsmead Academy:   

Kingsmead School is a rural mixed ability Academy with a fully comprehensive intake situated near the Devon/Somerset border, close to the Brendon Hills and Exmoor. It is a magnificent area in which to live and work. Not only is there the tranquillity and beauty of the countryside but there is the rapidly growing county town of Taunton nearby and easy access (20 minutes) to the M5 for connections to the rest of the country.   

The school lies in the small town of Wiveliscombe. It caters for the age range 11-16 and has 884 students and just over 100 staff. Our latest Ofsted Report, in June 2022, gave an overall judgement that Kingsmead “requires improvement”. Mr J Eddy, Headteacher, joined Kingsmead in January 2023. He is determined to improve education at Kingsmead for our superb body of students.   

The core values of Kingsmead are Care, Aspiration, Respect and Determination which drive our strong positive ethos and offering amenities for the whole school community. We have high expectations and expect staff to support our caring, student-centred ethos to set high standards for our students. We hope staff will contribute to and lead some of the wide range of extra-curricular opportunities we offer.   

Why work at CLF?   

We are a diverse and inclusive community of 37 academies across five cluster regions in the South West that is committed to excellence and making a positive impact. Our people bring unique perspectives, but we’re all driven by a shared moral purpose and a passion for making a positive impact, whether in a teaching, leadership or support role. We’re proud to foster a culture where everyone can thrive, feel valued, and make a meaningful difference to the lives of others.   

We are an equal opportunity employer and proud to serve a diverse student population and our communities. We strongly believe that representation matters and so encourage applications from underrepresented and global majority groups including ethnicity, gender, transgender, age, disability, sexual orientation or religion.   

We aim to remove any barriers to employment, ensuring everyone can compete on equal terms. Job share, part-time and flexible working opportunities will be considered. 

What we can offer you: 

  • Access to a generous pension through the Local Government Pension Scheme (LGPS). 
  • Generous annual leave. 
  • A comprehensive induction and ongoing commitment to wellbeing and career progression, through a range of training, apprenticeships and in-role/wider-trust development opportunities. 
  • Well-being support through an Employee Assistance Programme. 
  • Health benefits, including wellness sessions, gym discounts, and flu jabs. 
  • A range of generous family leave options, including above industry average occupational maternity pay. 
  • Additional benefits like cycle to work scheme, on-site parking plus many more!

We welcome visits from potential candidates. If you would like to arrange a school visit prior to the closing date, please contact the academy/site directly to arrange a suitable appointment.   

As part of our commitment to Keeping Children Safe in Education (KCSIE), we do not accept CVs – a full education and employment history must be provided through our application form.    

Please note we are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.   

We reserve the right to close this vacancy early, should we receive a high level of interest in the role. Therefore, candidates are advised to apply at their earliest convenience to avoid missing out.

We aim to provide an inclusive and accessible recruitment process, and support employees throughout their employment. If you have a disability, are neurodivergent, or require any adjustments to support you through the application or interview process please let us know how we can assist.

title: Manager II, Developer Advocacy
description:
Headquarters: California, USA, Remote; New York, USA, Remote; Washington, USA, Remote

 Developer Advocates at Datadog are engineers who share their expertise with technical practitioners, help customers tell their stories, and represent the perspectives of our community inside Datadog.

 As a Manager II on the Advocacy team, you will lead our Community Advocacy functions. You will manage a team of Developer Advocates responsible for global programs such as Datadog Ambassadors, Champions, and User Groups, as well as opportunities for customer engineers to share their expertise through technical writing, public speaking, and other community contributions.

Across these interconnected programs, your team will enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, lead communities, and turn their experiences into compelling content and conference talks for Datadog and third-party channels. This role combines people leadership, program strategy, technical judgment, and cross-functional influence to amplify authentic customer voices, deepen understanding of Datadog and its products, and foster a thriving community of practitioners.

 What You’ll Do:

• Lead and develop a team of Developer Advocates, setting clear expectations, guiding priorities, coaching performance, supporting career growth, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture

• Own the strategy, goals, and roadmap for Community Advocacy, translating broader Advocacy and company priorities into focused programs and measurable outcomes

• Guide the continued development of our Ambassador, Champion, and User Group programs, creating clear contributor journeys, expectations, enablement, recognition, and opportunities for customer engineers to increase their impact

• Build repeatable systems that enable customer engineers to contribute technical knowledge, create content, share best practices, and serve as trusted leaders within their communities

• Develop a strong pipeline of customer stories by identifying compelling practitioners and helping them shape authentic, technically credible narratives

• Oversee the support, co-development, and coaching of conference talks by customer engineers—from identifying an idea and developing an abstract through content review, rehearsal, and delivery—for Datadog events, including our flagship user conference, DASH, as well as third-party industry conferences

• Establish measures of success for Community Advocacy, using qualitative and quantitative insights to evaluate program health, contributor engagement, content quality, audience impact, and customer outcomes

• Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, Customer Success, and regional teams to align priorities, identify opportunities, and scale customer participation across Datadog initiatives

• Ensure insights from Ambassadors, Champions, User Group participants, speakers, and other community members are shared with the appropriate teams inside Datadog, strengthening the connection between our customers and our products

• Balance strategic leadership with selective hands-on contribution, including coaching speakers, reviewing technical content, participating in community programs, and representing Datadog when appropriate

 Who You Are:

• You are an experienced people manager who has led autonomous technical professionals, coached performance, developed talent, and translated complex goals into achievable plans

• You have experience defining and delivering successful developer advocacy, developer relations, technical community, or a related functions

• You have built or meaningfully contributed to programs that enable external practitioners to participate, contribute, create content, or lead communities at scale

• You have experience helping technical practitioners develop and communicate their stories, including coaching conference speakers or co-developing technically credible talks and content

• You are a former software developer, SRE, or other technical practitioner—or have equivalent technical depth—with the judgment needed to assess technical accuracy and coach effective technical narratives

• You are a thoughtful cross-functional leader who can build alignment, make prioritization decisions, and influence partners across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Events, and customer-facing organizations

• You use both data and community insight to evaluate program effectiveness, identify opportunities, and make decisions about where the team should invest

• You understand how to build trust with technical communities and value authentic practitioner voices over purely promotional messaging

• You are comfortable operating through ambiguity, establishing structure where needed, and evolving programs as Datadog’s products, customers, and technical audiences grow

 Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 Benefits and Growth:

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• Intradepartmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• An inclusive company culture, ability to join our Community Guilds (Datadog employee resource groups)

• Access to Inclusion Talks, our Internal panel discussions

• Free, global mental health benefits for employees and dependents age 6+

• Competitive global benefits

 Benefits and Growth listed above may vary based on the country of your employment and the nature of your employment with Datadog.

 #LI-Remote
 Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

 $212,000 — $265,000 USD

 Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram , LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.

title: Director of Public Policy, UAE/Middle East
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

 At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

 A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

 As the Director of MENA Public Policy you will develop and implement an engagement strategy with key policymakers, stakeholders, and opinion leaders across MENA. The successful candidate will oversee critical issues including, but not limited to, gaming, child safety, artificial intelligence, privacy, and consumer protection.

 The ideal candidate is a strategic thinker, driven to develop and execute creative strategies that advance Roblox’s business and priorities within the region. This position is based in Dubai and reports directly to the Head of Public Policy, Europe and MENA. The Director of MENA Public Policy will play a critical part in shaping Roblox's future in the country by establishing and executing effective public policy strategies. This role is instrumental in ensuring compliance, addressing policy issues, and fostering strong relationships with external partners, ultimately contributing to a safer and more engaging environment for Roblox's global community of developers and creators.

 You Will

• Maintain and build relationships with regional policymakers and political figures

• Identify, monitor, and analyze policy issues affecting Roblox in MENA

• Develop and execute policy strategies around issues important to Roblox

• Assist the wider public policy team on ongoing projects and initiatives

• Advise Roblox internal stakeholders on policy matters as inputs to the development of our products and business operations

• Articulate Roblox’s public policy positions and produce briefing papers and consultation responses

• Empowered to fully pursue both your personal life and career goals, with support to take on increasing responsibilities and calculated risks for growth

 You Have

• Bachelor's degree or higher in Political Science, Public Policy, Law, International Relations, Media, Technology, or related field of study or equivalent

• 10+ years of experience working with policymakers and stakeholders in MENA

• Deep knowledge of the MENA policymaking and public opinion process

• Extensive experience in intelligence collection and analysis, strategy development, project management, cross-functional partnership

• Strong communication skills, verbal and written

 You Are

• Passionate about public policy issues in MENA

• A solutions-driven and results-oriented strategic thinker

• A dynamic and engaging presenter with stellar oral delivery

• Detail-oriented, with strong communication, planning and organizational skills

• Self-directed, with the ability to define your own work and processes

• A team player, who values collaboration and partnership

• You are a professional who approaches every individual as a client, regardless of their position, maintaining a calm and professional demeanor

title: Senior Customer Engineer - Collibra Public Sector
description:
Headquarters: Remote, USA

 J oining Collibra’s Public Sector team

 The Federal Customer Engineer (CE) serves as the guiding force behind bringing Collibra Public Sector's (CPS) product and vision to customers and prospects. Senior Customer Engineers are responsible for both net-new and expansion opportunities in existing accounts. They establish knowledgeable and trusted relationships from day one and serve as thoughtful technical advisors. The CE maintains a technical relationship with customers throughout the entire customer journey, both pre- and post-sale. You will fill an essential and highly respected role in the sales organization at CPS.

 As a Federal Customer Engineer at Collibra Public Sector, you will support our nation’s most critical agencies in achieving Data Sovereignty and Mission Intelligence . You will partner with Federal Account Executives to navigate the unique procurement and technical landscapes of the DoW, Civilian and the Intelligence Community agencies. Your goal is to show how Collibra’s Self-Hosted and FedRAMP-authorized platforms can break down agency silos, ensure regulatory compliance, and accelerate the secure adoption of AI.

 Senior Customer Engineers at Collibra are responsible for

 Presales

• Lead in-depth technical discovery sessions to uncover complex needs and environments and recommend solutions

• Owns delivery of technical evaluation efforts with input from specialists for (Data Quality, Privacy, AI Governance and the core Collibra Platform).

• Works closely with the Account Executive to craft win-win sales proposals and influence decisions.

• Participates in discovery and drives qualification of new opportunities, and expands Collibra solutions with existing customers.

• Prepares and owns functional and technical sections of RFPs/RFQs.

 Demonstration/Presentation delivery

• Deliver focussed demonstration, creating sample/custom assets and configure workflows as required to meet client needs.

• Deliver focused presentations and roadmaps to key stakeholders across both business and technology

• Deliver complex tailored demonstrations and discuss in detail customization capabilities for specific use cases.

• Present tailored product roadmap presentation based on customer's priorities and current/future use cases

• Deliver complex multi-disciplinary workshops from start to finish involving internal and external stakeholders.

• Lead and own workshops, be the key driver for the agenda, and ensure outcomes result in positive outcomes for client and Collibra.

• Lead product and technical sections of regular business reviews with key customers

• Prepare and conduct product demonstrations, highlighting how Collibra’s Platform can support our Federal Government customer requirements.

• Identifying, evaluating, recommending, and executing value-based workshops and proof of concepts/values.

• Deliver tailored demonstrations that address specific Federal mandates (e.g., OMB M-24-10 regarding AI Governance, CDO Council priorities, and Executive Orders on Data Sharing).

• Lead technical Proof of Value (PoV) engagements within agency environments.

• Ensure successful deployment of Collibra Edge behind agency firewalls.

 Relationship Management

• Acts as the technical authority on Collibra’s security posture, including FedRAMP (Moderate), IL4/IL5 requirements, and SOC2 compliance.

• Acts as a liaison between the client and internal teams on complex requirements and issues that need clarification.

• Leads complex evaluation efforts, coordinating cross-functional resources, and complex testing scenarios.

• Document customer use cases and value realized (or to be realized for new) leveraging value consulting team where relevant.

• Proactively engages with senior-level and strategically important customer/prospect representatives, influencing product-related decisions.

• Develops executive-level credibility and trust, influencing customer-focused solution development and purchasing decisions.

• Build independent relationships to identify growth opportunities.

• Act as a go-to subject matter expert for specific product areas, industries, or complex technical domains.

 Adoption and Expansion

• Architect highly customized and integrated solutions for identified Agency use cases

• Collaborate with Solution Architects in providing guidance on solution design for new use cases.

• Support customer identification of value and ROI. Support customer use case library aligned to data strategy and business value, leveraging the services team when and where required.

• Actively support account growth strategies with the AE/AM.

• Understand in detail the specific differentiators for Collibra solutions, including strengths and weaknesses of competition.

• Provide thought leadership on best practices for adoption and technical optimizations.

• Influences product and service direction to enhance overall client experience.

• Design and validate future-state technical architectures for major transformation projects, integrating across vast complex ecosystems

• Mapping solutions to value across large and dynamic customers, bridging both business and technical requirements.

• Advising and supporting customers’ technical stakeholders to accelerate Collibra adoption and value realization, i.e., be the primary point of contact for technical and product-related queries.

• Architect solutions that function across complex Federal environments, including on-premises, hybrid cloud, and disconnected/classified networks.

• Help agencies build a "Unified Data Language" to facilitate secure data sharing between departments while maintaining strict access controls and data labeling.

 Customer Support

• Address technical questions, mitigate risks, and overcome objections related to security, scalability, integration and implementation.

• Identify adoption roadblocks and ensure successful product usage.

• Drive technical resolution and best practices for common challenges.

• Document customer use cases and adoption challenges, providing guidance on adoption/value realization best practices.

 Teaming

• Provides onboarding assistance for CEs and allied sales team members.

• Contributes to Customer Engineering participation in major projects and provides forward-looking technical guidance.

• Maintain expert-level product knowledge across the portfolio.

• Works internally to improve product marketing messaging and educate Sales/CEs.

• Provides team members with technical and process guidance and advice.

• Build and execute account specific competitive strategies, and contribute to the broader Collibra competitive landscape analysis. Understand the broader technology ecosystem and future trends.

• Packages best practices and lessons learned into thought leadership, methodologies, and published assets to improve Customer Engineering processes.

• Owns Customer Engineering participation in major projects and provides forward-looking technical guidance.

• Supporting sales and marketing activities, webcasts, field enablement, and asset creation.

• Providing advice and feedback to product management and engineering to enhance Collibra solutions and offerings.

 You have

• 5+ years in Sales Engineering or Technical Consulting, specifically supporting U.S. Federal Government customers with 4+ years working in the Data/SaaS space.

• Proficiency in SQL and deep familiarity with Federal data stacks (e.g., Snowflake Government Data Cloud, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and Palantir) are a plus.

• Working knowledge of NIST 800-53, FISMA, and the Federal Data Strategy.

• Proven ability to navigate the Federal procurement cycle and build long-term relationships with Agency CDOs, CTOs, and Program Managers.

• Experience should include a broad range of disciplines, including value-based selling, cost-benefit analysis, ROI analysis, process and project management.

• Experience in regulatory compliance and or (financial/IT) audit is a plus.

• Experience working with leading PaaS providers, data lakes, databases, and integration platforms is required.

• Familiarity in enterprise security solutions such as LDAP or Kerberos.

• Experience working with Data Quality, Data Pipelines, Data Orchestration, and/or Job Control tools.

• Knowledgeable of at least least two or three of the following: data management processes, including data governance, data stewardship, master data management, data cataloging, and business rules management

• Experienced with Collibra or comparable technologies

• Demonstrated proficiency in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT, Copilot) to solve real-world business challenges, drive measurable outcomes, or streamline workflows.

• A bachelor’s degree or equivalent related working experience is required.

• Hold active security clearance (Secret/TS).

• Because this role supports the U.S. government business, it is required that you are a U.S. citizen who resides on U.S. soil.

 You are

• Exceptional in communication, presentation and interpersonal skills including the ability to communicate effectively and build relationships within government entities.

• Fast learner with an aptitude for grasping complex technical concepts.

title: Threat Detection Analyst (Japanese Speaking desirable)
description:
Headquarters: Australia (Remote)

 Fastly helps people stay better connected with the things they love. Fastly’s edge cloud platform enables customers to create great digital experiences quickly, securely, and reliably by processing, serving, and securing our customers’ applications as close to their end-users as possible — at the edge of the Internet. The platform is designed to take advantage of the modern internet, to be programmable, and to support agile software development. Fastly’s customers include many of the world’s most prominent companies, including GitHub, Yelp, Paramount, and JetBlue.

 We're building a more trustworthy Internet. Come join us.

 Threat Detection Analyst - (Japanese speaking desirable)

 Fastly is seeking a Threat Detection Analyst to join our dedicated Customer Security Operations Centre. In this role, you will be a frontline defender for Fastly’s global enterprise customers. You will leverage our edge cloud platform and an array of security products in monitoring traffic, detect sophisticated anomalies, and deploy real-time mitigations against DDoS, Bot, and Web Application attacks.

 This is a high-impact role where you act as a strategic partner for our Managed Security Service (MSS) clients, providing the expert visibility and rapid response necessary to address internet-scale threats.

 What you’ll Do :

• Active Incident Response: Lead the identification and mitigation of high-impact security events. You will analyze sophisticated traffic patterns and implement precise countermeasures, including rate limiting and custom WAF & Security rules to neutralize threats in real-time.

• Managed Security Delivery: Serve as a primary security consultant for MSS Customers. This involves continuous tuning and refining of security policies to optimize detection accuracy and maintaining a hardened security posture tailored to each client's unique environment.

• Advanced Threat Hunting: Conduct data-driven investigations using log analysis to uncover potential threats and hardenings opportunities

• Security Intelligence & Reporting: Author comprehensive After Action Reports (AARs) and monthly security summaries. You will translate complex telemetry and attack data into high-level actionable insights for customer stakeholders.

• Strategic Communication: Act as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) during active security incidents. You will provide clear, calm, and professional guidance via real-time communication channels, ensuring customers are informed and confident in our defensive strategy.

 What we are looking for :

• Web Security Expertise : Comprehensive understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and advanced attack vectors (e.g., Credential Stuffing, API Abuse, and Layer 7 DDoS). You can interpret raw payloads to distinguish between malicious intent and legitimate traffic.

• Protocol Proficiency: Deep technical knowledge of the internet stack, specifically HTTP/S, TCP/IP, DNS, and TLS. You should be comfortable analyzing handshake processes, header structures, and status codes.

• Analytical Rigor : A methodical approach to digital forensics and incident response. You possess the ability to correlate disparate data points within JSON or CSV logs to reconstruct an attack narrative.

• Communication Excellence: The ability to distill complex technical findings into concise, professional, and empathetic communications for both technical and non-technical audiences.

 We’ll be super impressed if you have experience in any of these:

• Proficiency in Python or Bash for log parsing and workflow automation.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code/Security as Code(SaC) (Terraform) or edge-based configurations.

• Industry-standard certifications such as CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or Security+.

 Work Hours:

• This position will require you to be available during core business hours.

• Tuesday to Saturday : 10 am to 6 PM AEST and 11 am to 7 pm AEDT

 This position is a remote position based out of (locality), with the possibility of becoming a hybrid position as Fastly expands its presence in the region.

 This position will require travel to the US and Internationally, as required by your role or requested by your manager.

 Benefits:

 We care about you. Fastly works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We support our teams with great benefits that start on the first day of your employment with Fastly. Curious about our offerings?

 We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet your needs. Our offerings may vary depending on the country where you work and are subject to change.

 We have a huge impact. Fastly is a small company with a big reach. Not only do our customers have a tremendous user base, but we also support a growing number of open source projects and initiatives . Outside of code, employees are encouraged to share causes close to their heart with others so we can help lend a supportive hand.

 We are passionate. Fastly is chock full of passionate people and we’re not ‘one size fits all’. Fastly employs authors, pilots, skiers, parents (of humans and animals), makeup geeks, coffee connoisseurs, and more. We love employees for who they are and what they are passionate about.

 This contract engagement is open to candidates based in the Netherlands.

You will be an expert of the Dutch market, proficient in English and Dutch, and focused on proactive initiatives to build bridges with local volunteer moderators and innovate, iterate, refine, and scale our international consumer playbook.  What you will do:

• Gain a deep understanding of the market to identify user and local moderator challenges, and market opportunities.

• Iterate, innovate, and scale the consumer growth playbook by recognizing new opportunities, suggesting bold ideas and programs, and persuading internal teams to align on new plans.

• Build strategic plans to cultivate, recruit, educate, and grow a local community of moderators (i.e., volunteers who develop, maintain, and shape the culture of local communities). Implement a conversion funnel designed to onboard power users and external creators, transforming them into active moderators.

• Communicate quantitative and qualitative insights to optimize and improve the international consumer growth playbook.

• Be obsessive about achieving aggressive goals and outcomes.

• Analyze quantitative and qualitative data, set KPIs, and execute impactful community initiatives: leverage data to uncover community and moderator insights that will influence the direction of the local team in the market.

• Work cross-functionally with Product, Community, Engineering, Marketing, Safety, and BD teams.

• 5+ years of community development, project management, growth, operations, or product consulting experience with a track record of community-led projects that have driven business impact.

• Nuanced comprehension of the digital landscape and the cultural intricacies inherent within it, including awareness of internet culture specific to the Netherlands and an appreciation for the diverse cultural facets shaping contemporary Dutch society.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Realtime & Voice) Customer Experience Platform
description:
About the Role

HTS Assist is Hopper's agentic AI assistant for travel, resolving flight changes, cancellations, refunds, and bookings over chat and voice for some of the world's largest travel brands. We're looking for a senior full stack engineer to anchor this product, owning the realtime and voice layer end to end while building across React/TypeScript front ends, Scala and Python services, and cloud infrastructure. The team is lean and senior, ownership is broad, and the path from your code to a traveler's phone call is short.

What would your day-to-day look like

  • Own the voice channel end to end, including telephony and CPaaS integrations (e.g., Twilio, Amazon Connect), streaming speech-to-text and text-to-speech pipelines, realtime model orchestration, and latency and quality budgets

  • Build product features across the stack, including web chat front ends in React/TypeScript, backend services in Scala and Python, and infrastructure on GCP

  • Design for multi-tenant scale, with one codebase serving many partners through configuration rather than forks

  • Build the safety and compliance plumbing enterprise partners audit, including guardrails, content filtering, and PII redaction integration points

  • Keep revenue-critical deployments healthy through observability, alerting, incident response, and SLA performance

  • Build the platform capabilities forward-deployed engineers configure for partner telephony integrations and go-lives

  • Raise the engineering bar through code review, architecture reviews, and mentoring

An ideal candidate has

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with senior-level ownership of production systems and genuine full-stack range

  • Hands-on realtime systems experience, such as voice applications, WebRTC/SIP, streaming media, or comparable low-latency products

  • Strength in a modern front end (React, TypeScript) and depth on the backend (Scala or another JVM language, and/or Python), along with cloud infrastructure experience on GCP or AWS

  • A track record designing, building, and maintaining RESTful APIs, microservices, or event-driven systems

  • Familiarity using AI coding tools as a standard part of their workflow, with the judgment to review, correct, and own everything that ships

  • An operable-systems mindset, covering SLAs, observability, on-call rotations, and rollback plans

  • The ability to break down complex problems, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and ship iteratively, backed by strong communication across product, design, and operations

  • Bonus points for conversational AI or LLM orchestration experience, including speech technologies such as Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper, or OpenAI Realtime

  • Bonus points for working knowledge of cloud telephony or CPaaS platforms such as Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys, or LiveKit

  • Bonus points for experience building customer service, CRM, contact center, or workflow automation tools

  • Familiarity with travel industry technologies (PSS/GDS, hotel PMS/CRS) is a plus, though not required

Perks and benefits of working with us

  • Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary, upsides of pre-IPO equity packages

  • Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for the employee for a group insurance plan through Vitality Health

  • Automatic contributions when you start with Hopper through Smart Pension

  • Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards

  • Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk and a work-from-home stipend

  • Carrot Cash travel stipend

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business

  • Open communication with management and company leadership

  • Small, dynamic teams, massive impact

About Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally, powering Hopper's mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions, helping people travel better and save more on their trips.

The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. The Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers, with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.

While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we've grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world's largest brands.

Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners' direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company's recent growth:

  • Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS' channels every year.

  • Our fintech products, including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance, have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.

  • Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking, and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking versus if they booked just travel.

  • Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.

Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper's fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.

Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company. Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agency in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen Z and millennial travelers.

Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

title: Application Integration Developer
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Develop and maintain Python-based API integrations between our HR information system (HRIS) and business systems, including finance, travel, expense management, and recruiting platforms.
  • Build and maintain cloud-native services, web applications, and containerized workloads on Microsoft Azure.
  • Implement automation for system workflows, onboarding/offboarding, access-related processes, and data synchronization.
  • Create and maintain deployment pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code with Terraform.

  • Practical Python development skills, including maintaining and debugging existing services and automations.
  • Experience integrating REST APIs, webhooks, and Microsoft Graph API, with an understanding of pagination, rate limits, retries, and idempotency.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and Terraform for Azure deployments.
  • Good understanding of OAuth 2.0, Microsoft Entra ID, and managed identities for secure authentication and service-to-service access.
  • Experience designing and working with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MSSQL, etc.).

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience integrating HRIS or other business systems, such as ERP, expense management, or recruiting platforms.

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
